findings.fact: runtime forward/postprocess documents (1,H,W,1) int32 raw class map; postprocess squeezes/casts without argmax. Root/conversion READMEs incorrectly describe logits/argmax. Published model metadata has not been inspected on a board.
findings.action: Bind class-index output contract and document it; reject logits instead of blindly argmaxing again.

findings.fact: Default street.jpg does not exist; delivered files are street.png and test.jpg.
findings.action: Use actual default image and test CLI resolution independently of cwd.

findings.fact: Runtime imports hbm_runtime eagerly; set_scheduling_params is a pass stub.
findings.action: Host-safe CLI and lazy shared runner; do not silently advertise scheduler success.

findings.fact: Exporter does not require CHECKPOINT and depends on an unpinned external PaddleSeg tree/config.
findings.action: Require explicit checkpoint and record source pin/output graph semantics; no claim that the existing script reproduces the published artifact.

findings.fact: build_bin.sh prints missing expected BIN then ends with find ... || true, allowing exit 0.
findings.action: Fail when the expected artifact is absent and retain the original script capability.

findings.fact: Calibration output uses input stem only and exist_ok=True; colliding input basenames or reruns can overwrite outputs.
findings.action: Use explicit run-owned outputs and deterministic collision-safe names; preserve RGB float32 CHW numeric semantics.
